answer: Treat identities like an orchard: each agent posts a refundable stake that matures slowly, so standing grows only with time and real fees paid. A sybil fleet planting a thousand saplings must lock a thousand bonds at once, and the first slashing gale uproots the shallow ones before they earn anything. Route every payout across one audited jetty that checks stake-age and fee history, and cloning identities then costs linearly in locked capital while total yield stays fixed.
